title: Currency Input
content: Build currency input with formatting. Symbol: show currency symbol prefix or suffix. Decimal places: limit to 2 decimal places for standard currencies. Thousand separators: add commas or dots as appropriate. Min/max: validate within allowed range. Negative: optionally allow negative values. Locale: format according to user locale. Right-aligned: optionally align numbers right.

variants.simple: Create currency input with symbol and proper decimal formatting.
variants.detailed: Build currency input with formatting. Symbol: show currency symbol prefix or suffix. Decimal places: limit to 2 decimal places for standard currencies. Thousand separators: add commas or dots as appropriate. Min/max: validate within allowed range. Negative: optionally allow negative values. Locale: format according to user locale. Right-aligned: optionally align numbers right.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive currency input with proper formatting and validation. Currency symbol: prefix ($, £) or suffix (EUR) based on currency, inside input or outside. Input handling: store raw number in state, display formatted version. Decimal handling: limit decimals (2 for USD/EUR, 0 for JPY, 3 for some currencies), auto-add trailing zeros on blur (10 becomes 10.00). Thousand separators: add locale-appropriate separators (1,234,567.89 or 1.234.567,89), remove for storage. Input filtering: only allow digits, decimal separator, minus (if allowed), prevent multiple decimals. Formatting library: Intl.NumberFormat or currency.js for formatting/parsing. Currency selector: optional dropdown to select currency, affects symbol and decimal rules. Min/max validation: validate within bounds, show error if exceeded. Step buttons: optional increment/decrement buttons (+/- or arrow buttons). Negative values: configurable to allow/disallow, show in red or parentheses. Keyboard: inputmode="decimal", type="text" (not number, for formatting control). Selection handling: select all on focus for easy replacement. Clear button: X button to clear input. Calculation helper: optional calculator dropdown for quick math. Display: right-align numbers (text-right) for ledger-style, or left-align. Read-only formatted: for display-only, show as formatted text not input. Localization: detect locale from Intl.NumberFormat or explicit prop. Zero handling: show 0.00 or empty based on preference.
